clocks.quote: keep track of, document, and report, without undue delay, to the AI Office and, as appropriate, to national competent authorities, relevant information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures to address them
clocks.note: Art. 3(49): a serious incident is an incident or malfunctioning that leads to death, serious harm to health, disruption of critical infrastructure, infringement of fundamental rights or serious harm to property or the environment.

clocks.quote: a serious cybersecurity breach, including the (self-)exfiltration of model weights and cyberattacks, or if the Signatories establish or suspect with reasonable likelihood such a causal relationship between their model and the breach, not later than five days after
clocks.words: establish or suspect with reasonable likelihood
clocks.note: Two days for critical infrastructure, five for a cybersecurity breach, ten for a death, fifteen for other serious harm, each after the Signatory becomes aware of its model's involvement; a self-exfiltration of weights is the model's own act and need not have harmed anyone.

clocks.quote: frontier developer shall report any critical safety incident pertaining to one or more of its frontier models to the Office of Emergency Services within 15 days of discovering the critical safety incident.
clocks.note: A critical safety incident includes a model's loss of control causing death or injury and a model using deceptive techniques against its developer outside an evaluation; the second needs no harm.

clocks.what: Imminent danger, to an authority within a day
clocks.quote: developer shall disclose that incident within 24 hours to an authority, including any law enforcement agency or public safety agency with jurisdiction
clocks.receiver: an appropriate authority (law enforcement or public safety)

clocks.what: Timely sharing of AI control incidents and precursor signals
clocks.quote: share timely information on serious cyber and AI control incidents and other material precursor signals of serious harm, whether it's between companies and government, between governments or between AI companies
clocks.note: The signatories commit to align on incident classification; none is given.

clocks.quote: report any critical safety incident pertaining to one or more of its frontier models to the office within seventy-two hours from a determination that a critical safety incident has occurred
clocks.words: from a determination that a critical safety incident has occurred
clocks.receiver: office in the Department of Financial Services

clocks.what: Imminent danger, to an authority within a day
clocks.quote: the frontier developer shall disclose that incident within twenty-four hours to an authority, including any law enforcement agency or public safety agency with jurisdiction
clocks.receiver: an appropriate authority (law enforcement or public safety)
